args:
original_output=$(cmd uimode night) || exit; original=${original_output##* }; case "$original" in yes) target=no;; no|auto) target=yes;; *) printf "Unexpected mode: %s
" "$original_output"; exit 1;; esac; restore() { status=$?; trap - EXIT; cmd uimode night "$original" >/dev/null || status=1; restored_output=$(cmd uimode night) || status=1; restored=${restored_output##* }; printf "restored=%s
" "$restored"; [ "$restored" = "$original" ] || status=1; exit "$status"; }; trap restore EXIT; printf "original=%s
" "$original"; cmd uimode night "$target" >/dev/null || exit; changed_output=$(cmd uimode night) || exit; changed=${changed_output##* }; printf "changed=%s
" "$changed"; [ "$changed" = "$target" ] || exit 1
